name: packkit-e2e
description: Released-version ecosystem harness for Packkit — cross-repo journeys against published packages.

scripts.check: node --check run.mjs && for f in lib/*.mjs journeys/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done

//: Deps are pinned to the `latest` dist-tag ON PURPOSE and no lockfile is committed, so every `npm install` resolves what a user gets today (see SPEC §4). The recorded results/versions.json is the reproducibility trail.
